text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner of 9 Eriksdale Road to maintain an existing front yard fence. The fence, in its current state will exceed the permitted height of 1.2m for a front yard fence. The fence does not meet all of the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for a fence exemption by the owner of 9 Eriksdale Road to permit a 2 metre tall hedge fence on the condition that the applicant satisfies the requirements of Section 447-2(C) by removing part of the hedge to allow an unobstructed view of the highway or boulevard. Directed and require that at such time as replacement of the fence is required, the installations will comply fully with Municipal Code Chapter 447, or its successor by-law.
